title: Tiny, cute cactus in a pot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pot -->
  <path d='M30 70 L70 70 L65 92 Q65 95 62 95 L38 95 Q35 95 35 92 Z' fill='#D2691E'/>
  <!-- pot rim -->
  <rect x='27' y='65' width='46' height='8' rx='3' fill='#E8892B'/>
  <!-- rim highlight -->
  <rect x='30' y='66' width='40' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#F5A742'/>
  <!-- pot shading -->
  <path d='M60 70 L70 70 L65 92 Q65 95 62 95 L58 95 Z' fill='#B8561A'/>
  <!-- soil -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='18' ry='4' fill='#5C3A1E'/>
  <!-- main cactus body -->
  <rect x='42' y='30' width='16' height='38' rx='8' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- cactus body highlight -->
  <rect x='45' y='33' width='5' height='30' rx='2.5' fill='#66D96E'/>
  <!-- cactus body shading -->
  <rect x='55' y='33' width='2' height='30' rx='1' fill='#3D9140'/>

  <path d='M42 55 L32 55 Q28 55 28 50 L28 43 Q28 39 32 39 L34 39 Q37 39 37 43 L37 48 L42 48 Z' fill='#4CAF50'/>

  <path d='M42 52 L33 52 Q31 52 31 49 L31 44 Q31 42 33 42 L33 42 Q34 42 34 45 L34 48 L42 48 Z' fill='#66D96E'/>

  <path d='M58 45 L68 45 Q72 45 72 50 L72 56 Q72 60 68 60 L66 60 Q63 60 63 56 L63 51 L58 51 Z' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- right arm shading -->
  <path d='M58 48 L67 48 Q69 48 69 51 L69 56 Q69 58 67 58 L67 58 Q66 58 66 55 L66 51 L58 51 Z' fill='#3D9140'/>
  <!-- left eye -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='46.8' cy='41.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='54.8' cy='41.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 48 Q50 52 54 48' stroke='#1A1A2E' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush left -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='46' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#FF8FAB' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- blush right -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='46' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#FF8FAB' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- flower on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='4' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='1.8' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- flower petals -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='23' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='26' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#FF8FB3'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='26' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#FF8FB3'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='31' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#FF8FB3'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='31' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#FF8FB3'/>
  <!-- tiny spines -->
  <line x1='41' y1='36' x2='38' y2='34' stroke='#7DDB83' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='41' y1='44' x2='38' y2='43' stroke='#7DDB83' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='59' y1='38' x2='62' y2='36' stroke='#7DDB83' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='59' y1='54' x2='62' y2='53' stroke='#7DDB83' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='27' y1='47' x2='24' y2='46' stroke='#7DDB83' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='73' y1='52' x2='76' y2='51' stroke='#7DDB83' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
